librados-config is a utility that displays information about the
installed librados.

--version
Display librados version

--vernum
Display the librados version code
librados-config is part of Ceph, a massively scalable, open-source, distributed storage system. Please refer to the Ceph documentation at https://docs.ceph.com for more information.
